name: github-stars-button
title: GitHub Stars Button
description: Link to a GitHub repository with the GitHub mark and a star count that counts up when it scrolls into view. No fetch.

props.name: href
props.description: Repository URL. Unsafe schemes such as javascript: become #.

props.name: stars
props.description: Star count, passed in by you. Shown as 980, 12.5k, or 1.2M.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style, the same set as Button.

props.name: size
props.description: Height 32, 40, or 48px, the same as Button.

props.name: starsLabel
props.description: Hidden text for the count. {count} becomes the full number, for example 12,480.

a11y: A native a element with a 2px primary focus outline.
The animated number is aria-hidden, screen readers hear starsLabel with the full count.
The GitHub mark and star icon are aria-hidden.
With prefers-reduced-motion the final number shows right away.

ai.whenToUse: A star call to action in a landing page header or docs navbar of an open source project.
rules: Pass the star count from your server or build step, the component never fetches
Without a label give the link an aria-label
Use one per page, usually in the header

id.description: Tautan ke repositori GitHub dengan logo GitHub dan jumlah bintang yang berhitung naik saat terlihat. Tanpa fetch.

props.href: URL repositori. Skema tidak aman seperti javascript: diganti #.
props.stars: Jumlah bintang yang kamu kirim. Ditampilkan sebagai 980, 12.5k, atau 1.2M.
props.starsLabel: Teks tersembunyi untuk jumlah. {count} diganti angka lengkap, misalnya 12,480.

a11y: Elemen a native dengan outline fokus 2px warna primary.
Angka beranimasi aria-hidden, screen reader mendengar starsLabel dengan angka lengkap.
Logo GitHub dan ikon bintang aria-hidden.
Dengan prefers-reduced-motion angka akhir langsung tampil.

ai.whenToUse: Ajakan memberi bintang di header landing page atau navbar dokumentasi proyek open source.
rules: Kirim jumlah bintang dari server atau proses build, komponen tidak pernah fetch
Pakai satu per halaman, biasanya di header
